messages:
FinSightOps: Hey team — starting ~15:02 UTC we had a big spike of 504s on /v1/generate (streaming) for our tenant. Lots of user-facing failures and the SDK retries are creating duplicate charges. Sample trace id: trace-fs-98765. Region: us-west-2. SDK: python v1.4.2.

alex: ack, sorry you're hitting this. Can you paste one sample request id + raw SDK headers? Also roughly how many concurrent streams were active?

FinSightOps: request_id=rq-FS-20260318-001, headers: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>, x-tenant: finsight, x-client-version: fs-sdk/2.11. Concurrency ~120 streams during the spike.

ingrid: pulling logs now. I see upstream resets on the edge: `edge: upstream reset (remote closed) code=504 reason="kvcache-lock-timeout"` repeated. KV cache lock wait spikes at the same time.

matt_oncall: putting this on eng-runtime. tagging @eng-runtime. Quick mitigation plan: reduce per-tenant inflight window on the edge and add short-term retry-suppression in SDK for this tenant.

support_bot: Incident created INC-2026-3452, severity P2, assigned to eng-runtime and SRE.

jaya: For immediate repro and to confirm behaviour, run this locally (python):
```python
from threading import Thread
import requests

def hit():
    r = requests.post('https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate', json={"prompt":"x"}, headers={'Authorization':'Bearer X','x-tenant':'finsight'})
    print(r.status_code, r.text[:200])

threads = [Thread(target=hit) for _ in range(120)]
for t in threads: t.start()
for t in threads: t.join()
```
This reproduces 504s in our staging against the same tenant id (local stress).

ingrid: confirmed. root cause hypothesis: KV cache lock thrashing when many streaming requests hit the same prefix/kv paths — kvcache mutex contention leads to upstream timeouts. Edge waits on KV lock, request queues, then times out with 504.

alex: suggested short-term mitigations: 1) Configure tenant-level ingress smoothing for FinSight (rate-limit bursts), 2) set SDK to `max_retries=1` and increase socket timeout to 120s to avoid immediate retry storms, 3) route tenant to a fallback model variant lighter on KV usage.

FinSightOps: can you apply the SDK tweak server-side or do we need to ship a change? We can't update customer SDK quickly. Also we reported duplicate billing from retries — we need a billing credit for the window.

matt_oncall: applied ingress smoothing to the tenant pool and rolled edge patch decreasing `max_inflight_per_conn` from 64->32 for the pool (rolled at 15:28 UTC). Early signs: p50 unchanged, tail 504s dropped ~70%.

jaya: pushed a short-term client-side recommendation note to FinSight: `set retries=1, retry_backoff_ms=500, stream_timeout_s=120` and use `region='us-west-2'` to hit the smoothed pool. Sample config snippet: `client = RedwoodClient(retries=1, timeout=120, region='us-west-2')`.

FinSightOps: thanks — we applied the client changes and we're seeing reduced user errors. Still want credits for the duplicate charges. Can we get an ETA on a permanent fix?

sre_robin: we'll collect kvcache metrics (kv_lock_waits, kv_lock_time_ms, kvcache_waiting_clients) and heap/conn stats from the edge for the hour window. Suggest hunting for hot prefixes and adding sharding on kvcache keys as a longer-term fix.

ingrid: next steps for eng-runtime: instrument prefix heatmap, add KV lock metrics to the console, and explore lock-free read path for streaming hot prefixes. I've opened a runtime ticket RT-2026-089 for implementation.

alex: billing/CS: flagging this thread to billing-team and customer-success for credits and comms. CS to send apology + status update to FinSight.

support_bot: Update: incident INC-2026-3452 moved to monitoring. Next update scheduled in 30m.

FinSightOps: appreciate the fast responses — please include the repro steps and the patches in the customer update so they can verify.

matt_oncall: noted. We'll include the repro script and the temp SDK config in the comms. We'll follow up with a postmortem once RT-2026-089 lands.

sre_robin: action items assigned: capture metrics + store for PM and billing review; add to postmortem checklist: tenant burst handling, kvcache sharding, and retry-suppression safety guards.

FinSightOps: ok thanks, standing by for billing confirmation and the 30m update. :thumbsup:
